chapter: Building the band: Dave Duncan, Denver and Rene Hall
title: The Denver band's personnel, including Herbert Scott from Bessie Smith's band
summary: Roy Milton sings, and Herbert Scott, lately of Bessie Smith's band, plays trumpet with Hobart Banks, West and Nicholson.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So Roy Melton, when I told him about it, he went and put the little sparklers in so that when the lights show up--

The instrumentation then was Herbert Scott, Bessie Smith had come through there, vaudeville, and the blues singer, Bessie Smith, and they had practically broke up the band, so I got Herbert Scott as a trumpet player--
Hobart Banks on piano, Roy Melton was the singer and Spurgeon West alto and Eddie Nicholson was drums.
Yes, they were still with me.
